title: Appletini
description: Gin-based cocktail with crisp apple and dry vermouth.
instructions:
Combine all ingredients in a bowl with a pour spout. Stir briefly to integrate.

Pour ingredients into a glass, freezer-safe bottle with a cap. You may need to use a small funnel.

Let the bottle chill in the freezer for at least two hours before serving.

Pour a few ounces in a cocktail glass — ideally a very silly looking Martini glass. (For best results, chill your glass in the freezer for about an hour before serving.)

Garnish with thin slices of Granny Smith apple.

ingredients.raw: 2 ounces fresh Granny Smith apple juice

ingredients.item: London dry gin, such as Beefeater or Tanqueray
ingredients.raw: 7 ounces London dry gin, such as Beefeater or Tanqueray
